name: Angel Wish ~Houkago no Meshitsukai ni Chu!~
original_name: AngelWish～放課後の召使いにチュッ!～
source: You are an average high school student that has just moved to a new town. Suddenly, a girl in a maid outfit comes in front of you and says you are the prince of the country of Stella. Thus, you go with the girl to the country and you start living your life as a prince, attending school with cute girls!
